profiles.name: Default
profiles.description: The original Kiro Atelier look: thick impasto, a good balance between photo and paint.

profiles.name: Palette Knife
profiles.description: Loose, heavy impasto with real knife ridges; the photo shows through less. Twice as slow.

profiles.name: Gentle Touch
profiles.description: Stays close to the photo: same shapes and light, with a soft layer of paint over it.

profiles.name: Gallery Print
profiles.description: Best quality for printing or a big screen: extra detail pass, saved as PNG. Slow, large files.

profiles.name: Morning Wash
profiles.description: Soft watercolour: light washes, gentle edges, paper texture.

profiles.name: Monsoon
profiles.description: Wild watercolour: colours run and bleed into each other, far from the photo.

profiles.name: Poster Studio
profiles.description: Gouache: flat, bold colour shapes like a travel poster.

profiles.name: Pastel Light
profiles.description: Soft pastel: chalky strokes and blended light on toned paper.

profiles.name: Floating World
profiles.description: Japanese woodblock print: clean outlines, flat colours, patterned waves and clouds. Scenes and poses stay; faces take on the woodblock look.

profiles.name: Edo Landscape
profiles.description: Strongest woodblock look, for landscapes. People and action scenes get replaced.

profiles.name: Linocut
profiles.description: Woodcut print: bold carved black lines and a few flat colours. Best on landscapes.

profiles.name: Charcoal Sketch
profiles.description: Charcoal drawing: smudged black and grey strokes on rough paper, strong contrast.

profiles.name: Expressionist
profiles.description: Raw, emotional brushwork in bold, unusual colours. Shapes stay, colours go wild.

profiles.name: Psychedelic
profiles.description: Swirling patterns and vibrant colour, far from the photo.

profiles.name: Renaissance
profiles.description: Old-master oil on panel. Reimagines the scene: expect new buildings and people.

profiles.name: Dreamscape
profiles.description: Surrealist dream: strange objects appear where you don't expect them.

profiles.name: Art Deco
profiles.description: Geometric shapes, gold accents and bold colour. Reimagines the scene.

profiles.name: Layered Paper
profiles.description: Stacked papercut: cut paper layers with depth and strong contrast.

profiles.name: Shadow Box
profiles.description: Layered paper silhouettes lit from behind. Adds trees, moons and figures of its own.

profiles.name: Paper Quilling
profiles.description: Curled paper strips, coils and loops. Landscapes keep their shape; animals turn into ornaments.

profiles.name: Origami
profiles.description: Folded paper: crisp facets and pleats. Animals and buildings become paper models.

profiles.name: Light Files
profiles.description: Impasto at 1920 × 1080: small files for a laptop or a second screen. Paints as fast as 4K.
